from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_HALF_UP

# CONSTANTS
# Sec 16(ia) - Standard deduction amounts
STD_DEDUCTION_OLD = Decimal("50000")
STD_DEDUCTION_NEW = Decimal("75000")

# Sec 24(b) - Maximum interest on self-occupied house property (old regime)
MAX_SOP_INTEREST = Decimal("200000")

# Sec 71(3A) - Maximum house property loss set-off against salary
MAX_HP_LOSS_SET_OFF = Decimal("200000")

# Sec 80C - Maximum deduction
MAX_80C = Decimal("150000")

# Sec 80CCD(1B) - Additional NPS contribution deduction limit
MAX_80CCD_1B = Decimal("50000")

# Sec 80D - Health insurance limits
MAX_80D_SELF_REGULAR = Decimal("25000")
MAX_80D_SELF_SENIOR = Decimal("50000")
MAX_80D_PARENTS_REGULAR = Decimal("25000")
MAX_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR = Decimal("50000")

# First Schedule, Part III, Para A - Old Regime Slabs: (lower, upper_or_None, rate)
# Note: Age-dependent slabs are handled in code by determining the exemption threshold for nil rate.
OLD_SLABS_BELOW_60 = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("250000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("250000"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]
OLD_SLABS_60_TO_79 = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("300000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("300000"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]
OLD_SLABS_80_PLUS = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("500000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("500000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

# Sec 115BAC - New Tax Regime Slabs: (lower, upper_or_None, rate)
NEW_SLABS = [
    (Decimal("0"), Decimal("300000"), Decimal("0")),
    (Decimal("300000"), Decimal("700000"), Decimal("0.05")),
    (Decimal("700000"), Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("1000000"), Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("1200000"), Decimal("1500000"), Decimal("0.20")),
    (Decimal("1500000"), None, Decimal("0.30")),
]

# Sec 87A - Rebate limits and thresholds
REBATE_LIMIT_OLD = Decimal("500000")
REBATE_MAX_OLD = Decimal("125000")
REBATE_LIMIT_NEW = Decimal("700000")
REBATE_MAX_NEW = Decimal("2500000") # not directly used as flat cap, but rebate is min(tax, 25000)
REBATE_CAP_NEW = Decimal("25000")

# Surcharge thresholds and rates (First Schedule)
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS = [
    (Decimal("5000000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("10000000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("20000000"), Decimal("0.25")),
    (Decimal("50000000"), Decimal("0.37")),
]
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_NEW = [
    (Decimal("5000000"), Decimal("0.10")),
    (Decimal("10000000"), Decimal("0.15")),
    (Decimal("20000000"), Decimal("0.25")),
]

# Health and Education Cess rate
CESS_RATE = Decimal("0.04")


def round_nearest_ten(amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """Sec 288A/288B rounding:
    Paise are ignored (floor to whole rupees), then if the last digit is five or more
    it is increased to the next multiple of ten, otherwise reduced.
    """
    whole = amount.quantize(Decimal("1"), rounding=ROUND_FLOOR)
    return whole.quantize(Decimal("10"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)


def calculate_slabs_tax(taxable_income: Decimal, slabs: list[tuple[Decimal, Decimal | None, Decimal]]) -> tuple[Decimal, list[tuple[str, Decimal]]]:
    total_tax = Decimal("0")
    details = []
    for lower, upper, rate in slabs:
        if taxable_income <= lower:
            continue
        upper_val = taxable_income if upper is None else min(taxable_income, upper)
        slab_income = upper_val - lower
        if slab_income > 0:
            slab_tax = slab_income * rate
            total_tax += slab_tax
            upper_str = str(upper) if upper is not None else "Above"
            desc = f"Tax at {rate * 100}% on income between {lower} and {upper_str}"
            details.append((desc, slab_tax))
    return total_tax, details


def get_surcharge_rate(total_income: Decimal, is_new_regime: bool) -> Decimal:
    thresholds = SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_NEW if is_new_regime else SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS
    applicable_rate = Decimal("0")
    for threshold, rate in thresholds:
        if total_income > threshold:
            applicable_rate = rate
    return applicable_rate


def compute_regime(inp: dict, is_new_regime: bool) -> dict:
    gross_salary = Decimal(str(inp["gross_salary"]))
    age = int(inp["age"])
    hra_received = Decimal(str(inp["hra_received"]))
    basic_plus_da = Decimal(str(inp["basic_plus_da"]))
    rent_paid = Decimal(str(inp["rent_paid"]))
    rent_city_is_metro = bool(inp["rent_city_is_metro"])
    home_loan_interest = Decimal(str(inp["home_loan_interest"]))
    sec_80c = Decimal(str(inp["sec_80c"]))
    sec_80ccd_1b = Decimal(str(inp["sec_80ccd_1b"]))
    health_ins_self = Decimal(str(inp["health_ins_self"]))
    health_ins_parents = Decimal(str(inp["health_ins_parents"]))
    parents_senior = bool(inp["parents_senior"])

    trace = []

    # 1. Salary / Income breakdown
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Gross salary",
        "amount": str(gross_salary),
        "clause": "Sec 17(1)"
    })

    current_income = gross_salary

    # 2. Standard Deduction
    std_ded = STD_DEDUCTION_NEW if is_new_regime else STD_DEDUCTION_OLD
    std_ded_allowed = min(std_ded, current_income)
    current_income -= std_ded_allowed
    clause_std = "Sec 16(ia) proviso (Sec 115BAC)" if is_new_regime else "Sec 16(ia)"
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Standard deduction",
        "amount": str(-std_ded_allowed),
        "clause": clause_std
    })

    # 3. HRA Exemption (Old regime only)
    hra_exempt = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new_regime and hra_received > 0:
        cond_a = hra_received
        cond_b = max(Decimal("0"), rent_paid - (basic_plus_da * Decimal("0.10")))
        metro_rate = Decimal("0.50") if rent_city_is_metro else Decimal("0.40")
        cond_c = basic_plus_da * metro_rate
        hra_exempt = min(cond_a, cond_b, cond_c)
        if hra_exempt < Decimal("0"):
            hra_exempt = Decimal("0")
        current_income -= hra_exempt
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "HRA exemption",
            "amount": str(-hra_exempt),
            "clause": "Sec 10(13A) read with Rule 2A"
        })

    # 4. House Property Loss (Old regime only)
    hp_loss = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new_regime and home_loan_interest > 0:
        sop_deduction = min(home_loan_interest, MAX_SOP_INTEREST)
        hp_loss = min(sop_deduction, MAX_HP_LOSS_SET_OFF)
        current_income -= hp_loss
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Interest on self-occupied house property set off",
            "amount": str(-hp_loss),
            "clause": "Sec 24(b) and Sec 71(3A)"
        })

    if current_income < 0:
        current_income = Decimal("0")

    gti = current_income

    # 5. Chapter VI-A Deductions (Old regime only)
    total_deductions = Decimal("0")
    if not is_new_regime:
        # Sec 80C
        ded_80c = min(sec_80c, MAX_80C)
        if ded_80c > 0:
            total_deductions += ded_80c
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80C",
                "amount": str(-ded_80c),
                "clause": "Sec 80C"
            })

        # Sec 80CCD(1B)
        ded_80ccd = min(sec_80ccd_1b, MAX_80CCD_1B)
        if ded_80ccd > 0:
            total_deductions += ded_80ccd
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80CCD(1B)",
                "amount": str(-ded_80ccd),
                "clause": "Sec 80CCD(1B)"
            })

        # Sec 80D
        limit_self = MAX_80D_SELF_SENIOR if age >= 60 else MAX_80D_SELF_REGULAR
        ded_self = min(health_ins_self, limit_self)
        limit_parents = MAX_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR if parents_senior else MAX_80D_PARENTS_REGULAR
        ded_parents = min(health_ins_parents, limit_parents)
        ded_80d = ded_self + ded_parents
        if ded_80d > 0:
            total_deductions += ded_80d
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80D (health insurance)",
                "amount": str(-ded_80d),
                "clause": "Sec 80D"
            })

        # Sec 80A(2) overall cap: deductions cannot exceed GTI
        if total_deductions > gti:
            excess = total_deductions - gti
            # Adjust the trace entries or handle cap
            # To be precise, let's cap total_deductions at gti
            total_deductions = gti

    # Net taxable income before Sec 288A
    unrounded_total_income = max(Decimal("0"), gti - total_deductions)
    total_income = round_nearest_ten(unrounded_total_income)

    inc_rounding_diff = total_income - unrounded_total_income
    if inc_rounding_diff != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Rounding adjustment",
            "amount": str(inc_rounding_diff),
            "clause": "Sec 288A"
        })

    # 6. Tax computation
    if is_new_regime:
        slabs = NEW_SLABS
    else:
        if age >= 80:
            slabs = OLD_SLABS_80_PLUS
        elif age >= 60:
            slabs = OLD_SLABS_60_TO_79
        else:
            slabs = OLD_SLABS_BELOW_60

    slab_tax, slab_details = calculate_slabs_tax(total_income, slabs)
    for desc, amt in slab_details:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": desc,
            "amount": str(amt),
            "clause": "First Schedule, Part III, Para A"
        })

    tax_after_slab = slab_tax

    # 7. Rebate Sec 87A
    rebate = Decimal("0")
    if is_new_regime:
        if total_income <= REBATE_LIMIT_NEW:
            rebate = min(tax_after_slab, REBATE_CAP_NEW)
        else:
            # Marginal relief for new regime Sec 87A
            # where total income exceeds 7,00,000 and tax payable exceeds (total_income - 7,00,000)
            excess_income = total_income - REBATE_LIMIT_NEW
            if tax_after_slab > excess_income:
                rebate = tax_after_slab - excess_income
    else:
        if total_income <= REBATE_LIMIT_OLD:
            rebate = min(tax_after_slab, REBATE_MAX_OLD)

    if rebate > 0:
        tax_after_slab -= rebate
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rebate under Section 87A",
            "amount": str(-rebate),
            "clause": "Sec 87A"
        })

    # 8. Surcharge and Surcharge Marginal Relief
    surcharge_rate = get_surcharge_rate(total_income, is_new_regime)
    surcharge = tax_after_slab * surcharge_rate

    surcharge_marginal_relief = Decimal("0")
    if surcharge_rate > 0:
        # Find applicable threshold
        thresholds = SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS_NEW if is_new_regime else SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS
        applicable_threshold = Decimal("0")
        for thresh, rate in thresholds:
            if total_income > thresh:
                applicable_threshold = thresh

        if applicable_threshold > 0:
            # Tax + Surcharge on total income
            tax_plus_sur_actual = tax_after_slab + surcharge
            
            # Tax + Surcharge at threshold
            thresh_slab_tax, _ = calculate_slabs_tax(applicable_threshold, slabs)
            # Rebate at threshold if any
            thresh_rebate = Decimal("0")
            if is_new_regime:
                if applicable_threshold <= REBATE_LIMIT_NEW:
                    thresh_rebate = min(thresh_slab_tax, REBATE_CAP_NEW)
            else:
                if applicable_threshold <= REBATE_LIMIT_OLD:
                    thresh_rebate = min(thresh_slab_tax, REBATE_MAX_OLD)
            thresh_tax_net = thresh_slab_tax - thresh_rebate
            thresh_sur_rate = get_surcharge_rate(applicable_threshold, is_new_regime)
            thresh_sur = thresh_tax_net * thresh_sur_rate
            tax_plus_sur_thresh = thresh_tax_net + thresh_sur

            max_allowed = tax_plus_sur_thresh + (total_income - applicable_threshold)
            if tax_plus_sur_actual > max_allowed:
                surcharge_marginal_relief = tax_plus_sur_actual - max_allowed

    if surcharge > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Surcharge",
            "amount": str(surcharge),
            "clause": "First Schedule"
        })

    if surcharge_marginal_relief > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Surcharge marginal relief",
            "amount": str(-surcharge_marginal_relief),
            "clause": "First Schedule"
        })

    tax_after_surcharge = tax_after_slab + surcharge - surcharge_marginal_relief

    # 9. Health and Education Cess
    cess = tax_after_surcharge * CESS_RATE
    if cess > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Health and Education Cess",
            "amount": str(cess),
            "clause": "Health and Education Cess"
        })

    unrounded_tax_payable = tax_after_surcharge + cess
    tax_payable = round_nearest_ten(unrounded_tax_payable)

    tax_rounding_diff = tax_payable - unrounded_tax_payable
    if tax_rounding_diff != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rounding adjustment",
            "amount": str(tax_rounding_diff),
            "clause": "Sec 288B"
        })

    return {
        "total_income": int(total_income),
        "tax_payable": int(tax_payable),
        "trace": trace
    }


def compute(inp: dict) -> dict:
    old_result = compute_regime(inp, is_new_regime=False)
    new_result = compute_regime(inp, is_new_regime=True)
    return {
        "old": old_result,
        "new": new_result
    }
